segments.text: Phil’s father, Frank, arrives in his motor home with a dog named Scout. He says he cannot take care of the dog for a while and asks the Dunphys to keep him. Claire strongly objects because she believes the house is already chaotic enough.

segments.text: However, after spending time with Scout, she becomes the person most attached to him. When Frank decides to take the dog with him again, Claire pretends not to care, but she is clearly heartbroken.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay meets Ben, one of Mitchell’s old acting friends, who has appeared in a new horror movie. Jay does not realize it is a horror film and takes Manny to see it. Manny becomes terrified and starts sleeping in Jay and Gloria’s bed.

segments.text: Jay invites Ben to the house to show Manny that the actor is just a normal person. Unfortunately, the doorbell is broken, so Ben appears outside the window while holding a fake machete from the movie. Instead of curing Manny’s fear, the visit makes it much worse.

segments.text: Overall, the episode shows that even a short experience can reveal a new side of someone. Claire discovers how attached she can become, and Cameron gets to be a performer again, even if only for one night.
